player.name: J Trim
player.placeOfDeath: New Amsterdam, West Bank, Berbice, British Guiana

items.html: John Trim, who died in hospital in British Guiana on November 12, aged 45, played in four Test matches for the West Indies. A right-arm fast-medium bowler, he gained his First Test Match honours on the strength of a good performance for British Guiana, for whom he made his debut in 1944, against G. O. Allen's M.C.C. Team in 1947-48 when at Georgetown he earned analyses of four wickets for 68 runs and five for 36. He toured India in 1948 and Australia in 1951. In all he took 18 Test wickets, average 16.16.
